name: Broad clinical genetic testing
title: Clinical genetic testing after Invitae: blocked on a check
question: Is broad clinical genetic testing viable again after Invitae went bankrupt?
answer: Invitae sold broad genetic test panels at low prices, grew volume quickly, and filed for bankruptcy in February 2024; Labcorp bought its assets. Sequencing kept getting cheaper; what failed was getting paid, with insurers denying many claims. Whether payer coverage for broad panels has improved since 2024 is the check that decides this.
verdict_reason: Cost keeps falling; the binding constraint, reimbursement, has no public series yet.

constraint.name: Insurer reimbursement for broad panels
constraint.detail: Volume grew, but revenue per test stayed low because payers denied or underpaid claims.

graveyard.name: Invitae
graveyard.how: Chapter 11, February 2024; assets bought by Labcorp

evidence.text: FDA's laboratory-developed tests rule is published (later vacated by a court in 2025).
FDA removes the LDT rule's provisions to implement the court's vacatur.
